In other words, global warming ended a period of glaciation that had already begun.

items.title: Earth's hemispheres may have worked together to drive past ice ages

Published today (Oct. 22) in the Journal of Climate, the paper links ice sheets in the Northern Hemisphere to changes in ocean circulation and sea ice in the Southern Hemisphere understood to drive down atmospheric CO₂. Linking these two key features of the ice ages has long been a challenge, given how far apart the two regions are.

Connor Zilisch says every trip through the Phoenix dogleg registers about a 10G hit on his mouthpiece sensor. He is torn on whether NASCAR should change it. The dogleg is a bend on the Phoenix frontstretch, near the start/finish line. Drivers can cut low across the flat area below it, which used to be grass, before climbing back onto the banked racing surface. The data came from a mouthpiece sensor that many Cup drivers wear. A team at Wake Forest University School of Medicine developed it to record head motion and impacts. Drivers have worn it since the 2023 season.
